project_metadata.framework: Expo React Native with Web Preview
project_metadata.glovo_style_paradigm: City-filtered exploration, dynamic category chips, provider spotlight cards, quick booking drawers, and dedicated merchant hub

home_delivery_chef_section.city_selector: Sticky top bar with city picker pill ('Città e Raggio'), explicit search input, and location radius badge (e.g., 'Milano - Entro 25km').
home_delivery_chef_section.category_chips: Horizontal scrollable chips for service filters ('Cena Romantica', 'Anniversario', 'Catering Eventi', 'Personal Chef Settimanale', 'Showcooking').
home_delivery_chef_section.chef_cards: Bento style cards featuring provider photo/avatar, verified badge, rating (e.g. 4.9 ★ (34)), starting price, service area radius, and top signature dish tag.
home_delivery_chef_section.booking_modal_drawer: Instant booking (date/guests/time slot selection) vs Custom Quote Request ('Richiedi Preventivo').

components: Header showcase with cover image & profile avatar
Bio, culinary specialties, and experience level
Signature Dishes Showcase ('Piatti Forti & Cavalli di Battaglia')
Services offered with pricing structure (Instant price vs Custom quote)
Verified Customer Reviews with detailed ratings

negozio_accademia_provider_hub.registration_onboarding: Dedicated registration flow for Chefs & Catering Companies to create their professional Delivery Card, select coverage cities, operating radius, and pricing strategy.
negozio_accademia_provider_hub.provider_dashboard: Order management feed (Pending, Confirmed, Completed), Economic performance chart & earnings breakdown (Net payout vs 10% platform fee), Calendar for appointments, and Review response center.

admin_delivery_control_panel.commission_structure: Automatic 10% platform fee tracking on all requests. Direct client checkout with fee split visualizer.
admin_delivery_control_panel.management: Chef verification & approval queue, order overview, refund/dispute status, payout readiness indicators (Stripe Connect setup state).

legacy_features_status.course_sales: Digital course purchases stay on RevenueCat/native stores; never Stripe Connect. Activate only after matching store products and verified digital fulfillment are configured.

component_design_rules.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (8px, 16px, 24px, 32px padding/gaps) to keep layouts breathable.
component_design_rules.border_radii: sm: 8px, md: 16px, lg: 24px, pill: 999px for interactive buttons and badges.
component_design_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with tactile press states (active opacity 0.85). Primary buttons use brandPrimary (#799488) or brandSecondary (#D98364).
component_design_rules.cards: Subtle borders using theme border color (#EAE5D9 / #383C3A) with subtle surface elevated backgrounds. No harsh dark drop shadows.

stripe_connect_compliance.honest_readiness_state: Real platform connection requires Stripe Connect account configuration. Display clear readiness/error banners for automated payouts without fake balance generation.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, text inputs, card items, modal triggers, and status indicators MUST include explicit 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='delivery-chef-search-input', data-testid='chef-profile-book-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for standard body text against background surfaces.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.theme_support: Fully support dynamic light/dark mode based on system preference using theme tokens in theme.ts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme colors defined in src/theme.ts strictly (#799488 brandPrimary, #D98364 brandSecondary, #FDFBF7 light surface, #232524 dark surface).
Integrate the Delivery Chef section into the Home screen with Glovo-style search, city filter, category chips, and chef cards.
Ensure professional onboarding and provider card creation inside Negozio & Accademia.
Build provider orders, appointments, earnings, and reviews management dashboard.
Include Admin delivery controls for order status, 10% commission calculation, chef approval, and refund management.
Keep Ricettario PDF, Freezer Pro, Laboratorio, and honest Course Sales activation states.
Ensure data-testid attributes are present across all components.
